key_highlights: Global equity markets hit by severe turbulence with $5.7T wiped out in Wall Street's AI unwind and Nasdaq down 5%.
Asian markets experienced steep contagion led by Japan's Nikkei sinking 6.0% in its worst session in 18 months.
Data center and AI infrastructure face mounting scrutiny with $500M in loans being offloaded and pushback on mega valuations like Anthropic's $1.5T target.
U.S. macroeconomic data showed resilience with October nonfarm payrolls adding 165,000 jobs and unemployment dropping to 4.1%, curbing Fed rate-cut urgency.
Crude oil retreated below $100/barrel on post-midterm hopes for resolving the Iran conflict and hedge fund de-grossing.
Tesla signaled the termination of Cybertruck production by next year, pointing to capital discipline and EV segment rationalization.

sectors.trend: Severe valuation compression and skepticism over capex monetization following US midterm election outcomes.
sectors.implications: Multiples contracting rapidly across software and hardware; private tech valuations face major downward revisions.

sectors.trend: Credit stress emerges as loan sellers seek liquidity ($500M loan dump) and political focus turns to power consumption.
sectors.implications: Rising debt refinancing costs and regulatory bottlenecks could delay hyperscale capacity expansion plans.

sectors.trend: WTI/Brent dropped below $100/bbl on diplomatic hopes; gold pulled back on robust jobs data; copper faces supply tightness in Asia.
sectors.implications: Lower fuel costs provide margin relief to transport and consumer sectors, while industrial metals face persistent physical supply constraints.

sectors.trend: EV platform rationalization headlined by Tesla terminating Cybertruck production by next year.
sectors.implications: Automakers are abandoning low-margin experimental lines to refocus capex on profitable core vehicle manufacturing.

sectors.trend: Selective consumer strength with notable earnings beats from travel (Airbnb +12%) and specialized apparel (FIGS).
sectors.implications: Demonstrates bifurcated consumer behavior where premium experience and essential workwear providers remain insulated.

key_themes: AI Capex Reckoning: Scrutiny transitioning from narrative growth to tangible return on invested capital and infrastructure debt sustainability.
Political Reorientation Post-Midterms: Focus on consumer affordability and power grid constraints challenging tech and data center subsidies.
Labor Market Strength vs. Rate Cut Headwinds: Resilient 4.1% US unemployment limits near-term central bank easing latitude.
Commodity Divergence: Energy prices easing on de-escalation hopes while industrial metals face structural supply deficits.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AI Valuation De-rating & Private Tech Contagion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight high-multiple unprofitable software; hedge long tech beta via index put options.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Data Center Credit Freeze & Liquidity Discounting
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid leveraged digital REITs and distressed infrastructure credit tranches; audit collateral quality.
Increase cash allocation; implement trailing stop-loss orders across momentum-heavy holdings.
Rotate exposure toward domestic-oriented companies and firms with diversified ex-China supply chains.
Focus on short-duration fixed income and cash instruments yielding attractive risk-free returns.

opportunities.recommendation: Selectively accumulate tier-one semiconductor leaders on valuation overshoot.
opportunities.rationale: Chipmakers are beginning to rebound post-rout and possess structural cash-generation moats despite market noise.

opportunities.recommendation: Deploy capital into outperforming consumer travel and platform operators.
opportunities.rationale: Strong operational momentum and accelerating top-line growth insulate select platforms from broader tech capex doubts.

opportunities.recommendation: Establish long positions in industrial copper and copper miners.
opportunities.rationale: Major commodity houses like Trafigura are actively buying up Asian supplies amid immediate structural deficits.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim exposure to data center REITs and high-leverage infrastructure financing.
defensive_moves.rationale: A $500M secondary loan sell-off and post-election utility scrutiny indicate near-term margin and valuation compression.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Rationalize EV equity exposure away from speculative capital-intensive models.
defensive_moves.rationale: Discontinuation of Tesla's Cybertruck by 2027 reflects plateauing niche demand and high manufacturing cost pressures.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain elevated cash reserves and accumulate physical gold on rate-driven dips.
defensive_moves.rationale: Treasury bill yields offer strong defensive carry while central bank accumulation (e.g. China's 2-year buying run) provides long-term gold price support.

market_outlook.short_term: Defensive consolidation over the next 1-3 months as financial markets absorb tech de-leveraging, midterm policy adjustments, and credit renegotiations.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive 6-12 month recovery driven by more reasonable tech valuations, relief from sub-$100 oil, and resilient consumer fundamentals backed by steady employment.
key_catalysts: Federal Reserve policy response to strong October jobs figures (4.1% unemployment)
Diplomatic milestones toward ending the Iran conflict and stabilizing Middle East oil flows
Resolution and pricing disclosures from the $500M data center loan disposition
China's formal countermeasures against US corporate sanctions
Post-midterm legislative momentum regarding affordability and energy grid regulations
watch_list: Semiconductor index support levels and institutional tech flows
Secondary loan pricing and default rates in data center infrastructure credit
WTI and Brent crude futures pricing against the $100/barrel benchmark
10-Year U.S. Treasury yield and Fed funds futures probability curves
Retail investor net inflow/outflow metrics following recent multi-year dump records
